title: Git and Agile Mini-Project for New Team Members
target_audience: Engineers newly joining a project team
learning_goals: Recall the core Git branching workflow used on the team
Apply feature-branch development with pull requests
Apply Scrum ceremonies within a sprint simulation
Analyze merge conflicts and resolve them safely
Design a sprint plan for a small feature

context.learning_environment: Team room with shared repository and board
context.prior_knowledge: Basic command line, some version control exposure
